Converted from glTF to FBX and resized for the AR training scene.
- **Exit Door Double** by [moderncolin](https://sketchfab.com/moderncolin), from [Sketchfab](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/exit-door-double-0d1770e0baa942ecb14422f729b1f351), licensed under [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Converted from glTF to FBX and resized for the AR training scene.
- **Exit Sign 3D Model Free** by [Mohammad Rajabloo](https://sketchfab.com/MohammadRajabloo), from [Sketchfab](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/exit-sign-3d-model-free-79370d94bd6e4fc9a496de45b168f580), licensed under [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
